text:
Two frogs lived near a farm. One night, they were looking for food. They fell into a big bucket of milk.

The milk was deep, and the walls were high. They could not jump out.

The first frog said, “This is the end. We can’t escape. I am tired.” He stopped swimming and sank down.

The second frog was also afraid. But he said, “I will not stop. I will keep trying.” He kicked his legs and swam all night.

Hours passed. His legs were very tired, but he did not give up. Kick, kick, kick.

Slowly, the milk became thick. It turned into butter! The frog stood on the butter. He jumped out of the bucket.

In the morning, he was safe in the grass. He looked back and thought about his friend.

“If he had kept trying, we both would be here,” he said sadly.

Moral: Never give up, even when things look hopeless.

quiz.q: The two frogs fell into a bucket of milk.
Both frogs got out of the bucket.
How did the second frog escape?
o: The milk turned into butter and he jumped out
